title: Synthetic session one
turns: Good to see you. Did you find parking all right?
So what has been on your mind this week?
I had my review with Dana on Thursday, and I felt dread for days before it.
What happened right before the dread started?
Dana sent a message saying we need to talk about the roadmap. After that I went quiet and stopped replying to her for two days.
It sounds like you expect to be found out.
Maybe. When I was nine my father read my school report out loud at dinner and laughed at it. I could not breathe.
That sounds like a moment where being seen meant being laughed at.
I am good at my job, I know that. But in the review I kept thinking I am not good enough for this job.
Your GP diagnosed generalised anxiety disorder last spring, is that right?
Yes. And lately I have been checking the front door lock five or six times before bed.
What do you want to do before the planning offsite next month?
The offsite is on the ninth of February. I want to answer Dana the same day instead of hiding.
Let's stop there. Same time next week?
